name: Disclosure full.screeningBasis
value: Full single-phase basis: revenue is units times average unit price, net of a fixed 5% sales commission. Total development cost is land plus hard, soft and contingency costs and excludes financing costs. Return on cost is profit divided by that total cost. This is not the Quick basis (a lump-sum revenue with no commission or contingency).

name: Disclosure full.areaIsConstructionBasis
value: The buildable area entered here is the construction area used to price hard cost. It is not a zoning or regulatory floor-area figure.

name: Disclosure full.commission
value: The 5% sales commission is a fixed constant in the calculation, not an input.

name: Disclosure full.capitalStackRates
value: The capital stack uses a fixed equity rate of 0.20 and a fixed tax rate of 0.27. They are not inputs, have no stated source and are not verified. They feed the weighted average cost of capital.

name: Disclosure full.financingBasis
value: The senior loan is total development cost times the loan-to-cost percentage. Financing costs are derived by the calculation engine from the facilities (interest reserve and commitment fee); senior amortisation is a fixed 25 years; the presale deposit accrues no interest. Financing costs are not part of total development cost or return on cost.

name: Disclosure full.rlvBasis
value: Residual land value is not computed by this operation. When a separate operation provides it, single-phase residual land value is financing-inclusive, staged per-stage residual land value is financing-excluded, and neither equals the Quick residual land value (a share of sellout value).

name: Disclosure full.acquisitionBcOnly
value: The acquisition structure is calculated for British Columbia only and assumes a 0.5-hectare parcel for every parcel regardless of the entered site. Outside British Columbia the operation was not run; this does not mean no acquisition tax applies.

name: Disclosure full.taxNotIncluded
value: No tax applicability is computed by this operation. Where a separate tax operation is used later: its developer-profit figure is gross sales minus hard and soft costs only (excluding land, contingency, commissions and financing) and is not project profit or taxable income; after-tax figures are withheld; its GST/HST screening assumes a registered developer and residential units and is Canada-only.

name: Disclosure full.noCurrency
value: No currency or exchange-rate handling. All amounts are in the single, unstated currency entered.

name: Disclosure full.engineIdentity
value: The calculation engine identity is declared by the caller and is not verified here. Engine release versions are unknown.

name: Disclosure full.notAudited
value: This result has not been audited and is not tax or investment advice. Matching the prototype shows sameness with it, not financial or tax correctness.

name: quick.screening
value: Quick is a screening calculation, not a development appraisal. It is a different basis from the Full development calculation and the two are not unified.

name: quick.revenueBasis
value: Revenue is the gross sellout value you enter as a single total. No sales commissions, taxes or price assumptions are applied to it.

name: quick.requiredMarginBasis
value: The required profit margin is a percentage of gross sellout value (not of cost) and is used only for the residual land value. Full uses a return on cost, which is a different basis.

name: quick.softCostBasis
value: Soft costs are the soft-cost percentage applied to the construction cost total only.

name: quick.returnOnCostBasis
value: Return on cost is actual profit divided by total cost, where total cost is land plus construction plus soft costs. Financing, taxes, contingency and commissions are not included.

name: quick.simpleAnnualisedReturn
value: The annualised return is a simple compound annualisation of profit over total cost across the hold period, as one lump sum with no cash-flow timing. The hold period used is never less than 0.5 years.

name: quick.noTaxFinancingCurrency
value: No taxes, financing or currency conversion are included. All amounts are in the single currency you entered.

name: quick.notAudited
value: This result has not been audited and is not tax advice or a statement of production readiness.

name: Quick Cost And RLV Basis
value: Total cost is land + construction + soft costs. Residual land value subtracts construction, soft costs and required profit from gross sellout. Required profit is a percentage of gross sellout, not cost. Quick excludes contingency, sales commission, financing and taxes.

name: Quick Return Basis
value: Return on cost divides profit by total cost. Simple annualized return compounds the lump-sum return across the hold period, with a minimum of 0.5 years. It is not a cash-flow-timed IRR. Full uses a different basis and the results are not directly comparable.

value: Opening a new Full project will be added with native project creation and persistence. This draft does not provide that handoff, authenticated saving or live zoning lookup.
